dct_description_sm: Topographic map series of the Middle East showing international, provincial and district boundaries, transportation, communications, water features, religious, military, public and tourist sites and buildings.
Each sheet has individual name and number.
Includes adjoining sheet index, administrative index and Persian glossary.
